4Tify.name: 4Tify
4Tify.description: Agent App: Can reveal weak points by scanning your home. Or a section of cover...

Arasaka Prototype Heat-Resistant Barrel.name: Arasaka Prototype Heat-Resistant Barrel
Arasaka Prototype Heat-Resistant Barrel.description: Required to use the Arasaka Prototype Railgun Upgrade.

Arasaka Prototype Railgun Upgrade.name: Arasaka Prototype Railgun Upgrade
Arasaka Prototype Railgun Upgrade.description:
You may swap between firing modes at the start of combat or as an action during combat.

Required before use:

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.mlYhAxuDlI3fP9hq]{Arasaka Prototype Heat-Resistant Barrel}

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.nQF0M9n7cLvHS5RY]{Arasaka Prototype Rechargable Battery}

Arasaka Prototype Rechargable Battery.name: Arasaka Prototype Rechargable Battery
Arasaka Prototype Rechargable Battery.description:
Required for use by the Arasaka Prototype Railgun Upgrade.

Each battery contains enough charge to power 8 shots. The battery can be recharged in any power port in 1 hour.

CO2 Tank.name: CO2 Tank
CO2 Tank.description: A CO2 tank designed for usage with the Masetto AirRider armor. Must be replaced after every usage.

Digital Gladiator.name: Digital Gladiator
Digital Gladiator.description:
Agent App: A pvp battle game you can play on your Agent.

Rules related to creating, playing with, and fighting an opponent in Digital Gladiator are contained in Black Chrome rulebook for this item.

ModFire 10X (Rifle).name: ModFire 10X (Rifle)
ModFire 10X (Rifle).description: The ModFire 10X is an Exotic Heavy Pistol. Can also be transformed into an Exotic SMG or an Exotic Assault Rifle, assuming the user has all the needed parts.

ModFire 10X (SMG).name: ModFire 10X (SMG)
ModFire 10X (SMG).description: The ModFire 10X is an Exotic Heavy Pistol. Can also be transformed into an Exotic SMG or an Exotic Assault Rifle, assuming the user has all the needed parts.

Montage Digital Fashion.name: Montage Digital Fashion
Montage Digital Fashion.description:
Agent App: Allows users to purchase and select styles for their connected Montage Variable Clothing.

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.Rs94jDJRrbHVpvIh]{Montage Variables (Gang Colors)}

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.7fXDqCH4Z3ZLo5kL]{Montage Variables (Generic Chic)}

Montage Variables (Gang Colors).name: Montage Variables (Gang Colors)
Montage Variables (Gang Colors).description:
[Describe the color or pattern of your downloaded Gang Color Style here.]

Requires an action to swap styles via connected agent.

Additional colors and patterns can be purchased via the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.pDQRjH8q63YyoWSp]{App}.

Montage Variables (Generic Chic).name: Montage Variables (Generic Chic)
Montage Variables (Generic Chic).description:
[Describe the color or pattern of your downloaded Generic Chic Style here.]

NCPD Crime Database.name: NCPD Crime Database
NCPD Crime Database.description: Agent App: Requires CitiNet access in Night City. Allows user to research crime database.

Trauma Team MedScan.name: Trauma Team MedScan
Trauma Team MedScan.description:
Agent App: Requires CitiNet access. MedScan can connect you to a Trauma Team Remote Specialist but their actual guidance costs extra.

Rules related to cost of hiring and procedures allowed to be done with this App are contained in Black Chrome rulebook for this item.

Ziggurat City Database.name: Ziggurat City Database
Ziggurat City Database.description: Agent App: +1 bonus to all Local Expert Skills Checks related to communities and neighborhoods for that city.
